headline: Jubo Dal leader shot dead in broad daylight in Chattogram's Raozan
summary: Masudul Haque Chowdhury was ambushed by gunmen while buying medicine at a market; angry locals blocked the Chattogram-Kaptai road in protest.
details: A man identified as Masudul Haque Chowdhury, associated with the Jatiotabadi Jubo Dal, was shot dead at Chowmuhani Bazar in Raozan Upazila of Chattogram on Saturday.
The incident occurred around 2pm. According to Raozan Police chief Saiful Islam, Masudul had gone to the market to buy medicine when a group of men ambushed him and opened fire.
Locals reported that Masudul suffered a gunshot wound to the head. The gunmen fled the scene immediately after the shooting.
Following the killing, angry local residents took to the streets in protest, bringing traffic on the Chattogram-Kaptai road to a complete standstill.

Police and Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) members arrived at the spot to manage the crowd and restore order. Assistant Superintendent of Police Md Belayat Hossain confirmed that an investigation is underway to identify the attackers.
Raozan has seen a number of killings over the past two years, adding to the tension in the area.

headline_marked: 5 killed as [[Indian Air Force transport plane crashes]] in Assam
headline: 5 killed as Indian Air Force transport plane crashes in Assam
summary: An AN-32 aircraft went down and caught fire during a routine sortie at the Jorhat Air Force Station, killing all five personnel on board.
details: An Indian Air Force (IAF) AN-32 transport aircraft crashed and caught fire while landing at an airbase in Assam's Jorhat, killing all five personnel on board.
The aircraft went down inside the Jorhat Air Force Station premises around 10am local time on Saturday during a routine sortie, according to the IAF.
The victims have been identified as Squadron Leader Prashant Singh, Flight Lieutenant Shubham Kumar, Sergeant Jitendra Sharma, Agniveervayu Khemaram Kumawat, and Agniveervayu Danish Alam.
Emergency teams were deployed immediately to contain the blaze and secure the area after the aircraft went down within the airbase.
The cause of the accident is yet to be ascertained, and an official investigation is currently underway to determine the reason for the crash.
Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma stated that authorities are aware of the incident and are awaiting further details.
The Antonov AN-32 is a Soviet-built twin-engine turboprop military transport aircraft used as a workhorse for the IAF, with a fleet of around 100 aircraft.
The crash comes months after another IAF accident in Assam’s Karbi Anglong district, where two pilots were killed in a Sukhoi Su-30MKI crash.
